ve.assist.cli -> ve_experiments.assist_h: Assist CLI invokes the optional experiment backend; move this entry point to apps.
ve.ast -> ve.surface.nary: AST imports n-ary registration for wire decoding; split registration bootstrap from the core AST.
ve.backends.relay -> ve.ast: The relay reads VE_LEAN_SERVICE_POOL_SIZE's digits with the AST's numeral reader (ast.decimal_value); move the digit reader to the wire layer (AR-14 follow-up).
ve.closure -> ve.surface.registry: Closure substitution uses registered traversal hooks; extract a profile-owned interface.
ve.english -> ve.argument: English argument parsing also constructs tool-layer graphs; move the argument entry point to tools.
ve.norms -> ve.search: Norm dependency analysis reuses search's predicate walker (search._used_predicates); move that walker to the containers layer.
ve.rights -> ve.rights_route: Lean-first batch 7: RightsDocument asks the rights route for the accepted elaboration before constructing Python views; move the constructor beside the route when remaining profile constructors relay.
ve.units -> ve.search: Units count formula nodes with search's walker (search._node_count) for the aggregate limit; move the walker to the containers layer.
ve.wire -> ve.ast: The wire's formula tag table is the AST's (ast.WIRE_ARITY, read by wire.formula_tag_arity); move the tag table into the wire layer (AR-14 follow-up).
